B.definition: configured maximum target-heading motion primitives considered per source by forward transition generation; sparse-backward exact attempt counts require Stage-14.1 instrumentation

B_effective.definition: N_E/N_S_active; descriptive edge density, not attempted branching factor

N_C_energy_feasible.definition: candidates passing powered switching-state total-energy feasibility

N_C_feasible.definition: candidates with a complete feasible powered-virtual-glide mission

N_C_goal_reachable.definition: candidates with a virtual connection to the exact goal-backward set

N_C_powered_feasible.definition: raw switching candidates with a feasible powered segment

N_C_raw.definition: switching candidates generated before powered/energy/connection/reachability filters

N_C_virtual_feasible.definition: candidates with at least one admissible virtual lattice connection

N_E.definition: valid edges in the active corridor actually processed by hazard precomputation and additive Bellman

N_E_goal_reachable.definition: valid transition edges in the complete goal-backward-reachable graph before active-corridor restriction

N_S_active.definition: goal-reachable states in the forward descendant corridor of feasible virtual connections and processed by hazard/Bellman

N_S_admissible.definition: Cartesian lattice states whose position is not strictly inside terrain solid

N_S_cart.definition: full Cartesian count N_x*N_y*N_h*N_psi before terrain or reachability filtering

N_S_goal_reachable.definition: exact goal-backward-reachable finite states after terrain/dynamics filtering

Q.definition: configured trapezoidal detection-hazard samples for each processed edge
